draft.subject: Robotics and Embedded Systems Engineer role at SPAICE
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I applied for the Robotics and Embedded Systems Engineer role at SPAICE. Running AI models in real time on embedded hardware, on systems that have to behave the same way every time, is close to what I have been building.

For my capstone I optimized a YOLO detector with TensorRT on a Jetson and cut latency a lot compared with eager PyTorch. I ran the Jetson side as a systemd service with automatic restart, and I tracked down integration failures across sensors, firmware and networking. I have also written bare metal firmware for STM32, and I am comfortable at the bench with an oscilloscope and a logic analyzer. Day to day I work in C, C++ and Python on Linux.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
